overview: A modular monolith architecture for a private family media system enabling secure multi-user media asset management and timeline aggregation. The system comprises frontend, API backend, and asynchronous worker modules with tight integration and explicit responsibilities, adhering to minimal MVP constraints and preferred stack.

components.name: web
components.purpose: Next.js frontend shell providing user interface for authentication, media browsing, and timeline navigation.
responsibilities: Implement authentication UI flows integrating JWT tokens
Display photo gallery and music player with basic playback controls
Enable timeline filtering and navigation by time and asset type
Consume versioned RESTful API endpoints securely
Maintain clean UI with Tailwind and shadcn/ui components

components.name: api
components.purpose: FastAPI backend serving typed, versioned RESTful API endpoints orchestrating core business logic.
responsibilities: Define and manage core domain models: User, Asset, AssetVersion, TimelineEntry with SQLAlchemy and Alembic migrations
Implement JWT + refresh token authentication with role-based access control
Provide endpoints for media upload initiation and metadata retrieval
Aggregate timeline entries for unified timeline views respecting permissions
Implement permission system respecting private, family, shared scopes
Expose OpenAPI documentation for client integration
Validate and enforce strict typing and environment-based configuration

components.name: worker
components.purpose: Background task processing service handling asynchronous media metadata extraction and maintenance jobs.
responsibilities: Process uploaded media files for metadata extraction using ffmpeg, Pillow, mutagen
Perform background jobs such as updating AssetVersion thumbnails or caching metadata
Integrate with Redis as broker for Dramatiq or Celery for task queueing
Report processing status to API for user visibility
Ensure fault tolerance and logging within task execution

components.name: infrastructure
components.purpose: Local development environment provisioning and service orchestration via Docker and docker-compose.
responsibilities: Provision PostgreSQL database with initial schemas and migrations
Provision Redis instance for caching and task queue broker
Provision MinIO as S3-compatible object storage for media files
Manage Dockerfiles for api, web, and worker apps
Orchestrate docker-compose setup for seamless local startup and networking
Configure environment variables for inter-service connectivity and secrets management

data_flow: User accesses web frontend and performs login, frontend obtains JWT token from API
Frontend requests timeline data and media browsing data from the API using JWT authentication
User uploads images/audio/video via web UI submitting to API upload endpoint
API receives upload metadata, temporarily stores file in MinIO storage, creates Asset and AssetVersion records
API enqueues background metadata extraction task to Redis queue consumed by worker
Worker fetches uploaded media from MinIO, extracts metadata (e.g., image dimensions, audio tags) and updates database records
API aggregates AssetVersions and TimelineEntries querying PostgreSQL respecting user permissions to serve to frontend
User interacts with timeline UI in web, frontend requests filtered timeline entries with API
Auth system on API verifies JWT tokens and enforces role-based and permission scope access throughout API calls
